function detectBrowser(ua): BrowserInfo

Defined in: core/browser/detect.ts:45

Parses a UA string against BROWSERS. Regex pattern strings keep their escaped form so the same table survives JSON serialization into the inlined __LK manifest. The loop walks the ordered table and returns on first match — order is load-bearing (see browsers.ts header).

Parameters

ua

string

User-Agent string to classify.

Returns

BrowserInfo

Engine identity; other/0 when no pattern matches.
